title: Female early-marriage in Nigeria: A poststructuralist feminist reading of social disability in "Not That Woman"
core_idea: Use a poststructuralist feminist framework to analyze how social constructions of disability intersect with and inform practices and experiences of female early marriage in Nigeria as depicted in the literary text "Not That Woman".
tldr: A theoretical literary reading applying poststructuralist feminism to examine the relationship between social disability and female early marriage in Nigeria through the story "Not That Woman", aiming to illuminate how cultural discourses shape these phenomena.
